Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הַ֣חַטָּ֔את וְכִפֶּ֕ר עַל־הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר מִטֻּמְאָת֑וֹ וְאַחַ֖ר יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת־הָעֹלָֽה׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "הַטֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה ׀ אָזְנְךָ֙ וּֽשְׁמָ֔ע פְּקַ֧ח יְהוָ֛ה עֵינֶ֖ךָ וּרְאֵ֑ה וּשְׁמַ֗ע אֵ֚ת כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֣י סַנְחֵרִ֔יב אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֔ח לְחָרֵ֖ף אֱלֹהִ֥ים חָֽי׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "וַיַּגִּ֤ידוּ לַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֖ה נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֑יא וַיָּבֹא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לַמֶּ֛לֶךְ עַל־אַפָּ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "וְיֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י אַחְאָ֜ב וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה וּבֵ֤ית הַשֵּׁן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֔ה וְכָל־הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֑ה הֲלֽוֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "וְעִשָּׂרֹ֨ן סֹ֜לֶת בָּל֨וּל בְּשֶׁ֤מֶן כָּתִית֙ רֶ֣בַע הַהִ֔ין וְנֵ֕סֶךְ רְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין יָ֑יִן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "אֵ֤יךְ נִגְדַּע֙ וַיִּשָּׁבֵ֔ר פַּטִּ֖ישׁ כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֵ֣יךְ הָיְתָ֧ה לְשַׁמָּ֛ה בָּבֶ֖ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "וְאֶצְבְּעָת֙ רַגְלַיָּ֔א מִנְּהֵ֥ין פַּרְזֶ֖ל וּמִנְּהֵ֣ין חֲסַ֑ף מִן־קְצָ֤ת מַלְכוּתָא֙ תֶּהֱוֵ֣ה תַקִּיפָ֔ה וּמִנַּ֖הּ תֶּהֱוֵ֥ה תְבִירָֽה׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁא֡וּל וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָיו֩ וְנֹשֵׂ֨א כֵלָ֜יו גַּ֧ם כָּל־אֲנָשָׁ֛יו בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא יַחְדָּֽו׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "וְהָיוּ֩ עַל־אַהֲרֹ֨ן וְעַל־בָּנָ֜יו בְּבֹאָ֣ם ׀ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְלֹא־יִשְׂא֥וּ עָוֺ֖ן וָמֵ֑תוּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם ל֖וֹ וּלְזַרְע֥וֹ אַחֲרָֽיו׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָמ֖וֹהָ לְהָרִ֣יחַ בָּ֑הּ וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "כֻּלָּ֤ם הַבְּרוּרִים֙ לְשֹׁעֲרִ֣ים בַּסִּפִּ֔ים מָאתַ֖יִם וּשְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הֵ֤מָּה בְחַצְרֵיהֶם֙ הִתְיַחְשָׂ֔ם הֵ֣מָּה יִסַּ֥ד דָּוִ֛יד וּשְׁמוּאֵ֥ל הָרֹאֶ֖ה בֶּאֱמוּנָתָֽם׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד יְהוָ֥ה רֹ֝עִ֗י לֹ֣א אֶחְסָֽר׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהִשְׁלִ֨יכוּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים עֲלֵיהֶם֙ מֶ֔לַח וְהֶעֱל֥וּ אוֹתָ֛ם עֹלָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "וַיַּ֣עַשׂ ׀ בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם חִשְּׁבֹנ֜וֹת מַחֲשֶׁ֣בֶת חוֹשֵׁ֗ב לִהְי֤וֹת עַל־הַמִּגְדָּלִים֙ וְעַל־הַפִּנּ֔וֹת לִירוֹא֙ בַּֽחִצִּ֔ים וּבָאֲבָנִ֖ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת וַיֵּצֵ֤א שְׁמוֹ֙ עַד־לְמֵ֣רָח֔וֹק כִּֽי־הִפְלִ֥יא לְהֵעָזֵ֖ר עַ֥ד כִּֽי־חָזָֽק׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.

Is the following text from the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud? "אַ֤ךְ אֶת־זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל־אַרְבַּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר־ל֤וֹ כְרָעַ֨יִם֙ מִמַּ֣עַל לְרַגְלָ֔יו לְנַתֵּ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃" Answer Yes or No.
Answer in the language of the William Davidson Aramaic edition of the Babylonian Talmud.
